Subject: Oak Ridge Bank — CEO preflight: EA ops & secure escort plan

Team,

We have the Oak Ridge Bank CEO workshop next Wednesday (11/11). Attendees: Tom Whitaker (CEO), Angela Park (EA), Oliver Grant (CISO) + 6 execs. Goal: one-day strategy offsite (0900-1600) with a closed-room briefing at 1330. I need a short EA playbook and an onsite ops checklist so the EA/senior escort can run point. High-level asks below — please call out owners.

Top asks:
- EA playbook (single-pager + 1-page timeline): arrival, badge pickup, secure escort, briefing room layout, AV handoff.
- Secure escort/contact (Vivek) and pre-brief window for CISO security team (45–60m).
- Badge list in CSV for vendor badge printer (we'll upload to vendor portal).
- AV run & dry-run 90 minutes before doors. AV vendor details and contact.
- Limo pickup window: CEO arrives LAX 10:15 local — need confirmation of pickup ETA.
- Preload decks to a secure share (we need SFTP/DropBox instructions).
- Dietary: CEO is gluten-free; flag catering.

I've blocked time in my calendar for a 30m EA sync on Tue 11/10 09:00 PT. Laura, can you own the EA playbook and badge CSV? Marissa, can you confirm ground transport vendor and caterer? Vivek, can you confirm the security escort contact and whether we need to coordinate keys/KMS access or an HSM check at reception?

Attach: none yet — this is to start coordination.

Thanks,

Highlights/actions I assigned below: 

Laura (own): final EA playbook and badge CSV prep; coordinate badge printer credentials with facilities.
Marissa (own): confirm limo vendor and backup (I recommend two car options), confirm catering gluten-free entree + plated vegetarian.
Vivek (own): security liaison — reach out to Oliver Grant's team to arrange the secure escort and confirm whether physical KMS handoff is needed.

Checklist (short):
- AV dry-run 07:30 local (2 techs) — confirm HDMI & AirPlay fallback.
- Secure staging table near service elevator for KMS or HSM handoff if required.
- Badge printer on-call and badge CSV loaded by 08:00.
- Preload slide deck to secure SFTP (I created a folder — will share link after vendor approves IP allowlist).
- Final headcount: confirm by 14:00 PT tomorrow.

I uploaded v1 to our ops drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/ops/oakridge-prep (secure link). I'll update with vendor contacts as I confirm.

Attachments: EA_Playbook_OakRidge_v1.pdf; Venue_Floorplan_OakRidge_7F.pdf; badge_upload_template.csv (see attached filenames).

Jordan / Laura —

Thanks for the quick coordination. A few clarifications from our side:

- Arrival: Tom's flight lands 11/11 at 10:10 LAX (AA 324). Best ETA for arrival at venue is 11:05–11:25 depending on traffic; we prefer a 10:45 pickup from the private terminal if possible.
- Headcount: 9 total (Tom, Oliver + 6).
- Dietary: Tom is gluten-free; Oliver prefers no shellfish. Please ensure name cards don't use titles for security reasons (use first + last only).
- Security/KMS: Oliver's team will do a short handshake on-site — they'll bring the HSM token; they request a secure staging table inside the service corridor and that no personal devices be plugged into the HSM.
- Slides & preloads: Please share a secure upload link or SFTP details. Our security team will need the checklist and a SOC 2 statement; please also send a contact for your security reviewer.

I can confirm limo vendor (we have our usual car) but would like Redwood to provide an escorted route and a local contact in case of delays.

Look forward to the EA sync tomorrow.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround.
